spans.s: ऋषभ m. 1. A bull; 2. the best or most excellent of any species (in this sense it is generally used as the last member of a compound, e.g. पुरुषर्षभ); 3. the second of the seven notes of the gamut; 4. a crocodile’s tail.
ऋषभ-कूट m. the name of a mountain.
ऋषभ-ध्वज m. an epithet of Śiva.
ऋषभी f. 1. A cow; 2. a masculine woman; 3. a widow.
